# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.17 (pre-release)

Changes since pre.16 (24 commits). **No program behaviour changed in this release**: the differences are tests, documents and one script. Everything was run by the author's assistant on one Linux machine; nothing was tried on Windows, macOS, a phone, or with a hand-verified reference text. macOS builds are back in the CI gate and release matrix (GitHub runners were available again); if the macOS jobs failed to run for this release, the assets list will show it.

**Corrections to the pre.16 notes**
- The OCR wording in the pre.16 notes on GitHub is out of date; the corrected text is in the repository (`.github/release-notes/v0.2.0-pre.16.md`). The bridge's character-error advantage over Tesseract rests on one page (ROADMAP 4.36).

**OCR measurements (ROADMAP 4.34–4.38)**
- Built-in engine vs Tesseract vs the docTR bridge, page by page, on the same 12 magazine pages: the built-in engine has the lowest character error (2.76 % vs 5.25 % on the 8 good pages), but it was fine-tuned on text from the same kind of source, so this is not shown to hold on other documents (same-domain caveat in 4.37).
- OCRmyPDF (Tesseract) measured on the same pages: 4.62 % on the 8 good pages; no better than plain Tesseract.
- `scripts/compare-ocr-text.py`: compare any set of engines against reference texts (CER, CER without diacritics, order-free recall). The references are machine-made, so it measures agreement with them, not truth.

**Tests**
- Many options that had no test now have one (`--fit-width/--fit-height`, `--report-outliers`, `--verify-bag`, `--ocfl`, `--verify-ocfl`, Merkle proof, PDF signing round trip, `--burst-gap`, `--timestamp-verify`, stand-in OCR engine cases and more). `--sign-timestamp` is tested end to end against a time-stamp authority run locally over plain HTTP; a real HTTPS authority was not tried.
- 551 tests passed on Linux before this release.

**Documents**
- New: `docs/COMPATIBILITY.md` (proposed rules for how options and file formats may change; not yet confirmed by the author), `docs/TESTER-REPORT.md` (how to report from another system), `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- Competitor audit updated for 2026-11-05 (ScanTailor OCR, EVB Viewer, Aglaïa, ScanTailor PDF+, NAPS2) with prices from vendor pages.

**Open before 0.2.0**
- Rights to the scans and the textbook used to fine-tune the built-in model, and to the hand transcriptions in `docs/experiments/` (`docs/audit/assets-licences.md`). Until decided, treat the built-in model's licence as unclear.
- Reports from Windows, macOS and arm64 users; hand-verified Romanian reference text; PDF/UA and e-Factura CIUS-RO conformance; a real HTTPS time-stamp authority.
- Package recipes (winget, flatpak, AUR) are not submitted.
